rule: FDSN event services whose /fdsnws/event/1/query?format=text endpoint was verified live on 2026-10-14. IRIS is excluded: its event service was retired in favour of USGS (service.iris.edu answers 404 for the event query).

services.name: GEOFON (GFZ)
services.attribution: GEOFON, GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences
services.notes: Text columns end with an extra EventType column; Depth/km is spelled 'Depth/km'. No update-time filter: updatedafter answers 400 'invalid param' and its WADL's updateafter answers 400 'filtering based on update time not supported' (2026-10-22).

services.name: INGV (Italy)
services.attribution: Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV)
services.notes: Text header spells the depth column 'Depth/Km'; EventType is present.
